messages.en: The driver's already here, in the lobby. Are you coming down now?
Yeah, I'll just grab my bag and head straight down.
Has the new assistant started work yet?
Yes, he's at the front desk. I'll introduce you in a bit, okay?

senses.en_definition: A person who kills another person or other living things.
An instrument, substance, or other thing used to kill.

messages.en: Have you finished watching that series? I never suspected they were the killer!
Hey, don't say the name yet! I'm only on episode three. Don't give me any more clues, or I'll figure it out.

senses.en_definition: The act of killing, especially a person; murder.

messages.en: Have you read the news about that murder case? Someone shared a photo of the victim in our group chat.
Yeah. Please stop forwarding that photo—think of the victim's family. Just share the news link.
